integrity: Proof and finite corroborating checks are supplied; no independent scientific assessment is claimed. No assertion of resolving the unrestricted 1<p<2 optimal constant.
scientific_limitations: Sharpness is proved only among pairs of rank-one matrices with equal positive singular values; unrestricted Schatten constant may be larger. Full text of Pang 2608.18112 was unavailable; publication priority remains subject to independent inspection.
title: Unique overlap geometry and endpoint laws in the rank-one Schatten comparison
